operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception set forth in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a permit to an applicant if the person:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): (2) is at least 18 years old and a citizen or a permanent resident of the United States;
